attorneys: Mr. Nathaniel A. Brown for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Tom C. Clark, Messrs. Robert S. Erdahl and Leon Ulman for the United States.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment is reversed for want of substantial evidence to sustain the conviction.

Dissenting: Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas.
